entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number?
Mark Peterson, order number 774-B-91. Just tell me, yes or no, can I return it?

I understand you're looking for a quick answer, Mr. Peterson. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see it here. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The whole thing is just hard to use and the interface is really confusing. I looked at the user manual, but it wasn't much help. Honestly, I just expected more from the device.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see you received the delivery 8 days ago.
Right. So, can I send it back?

Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process this for you right now. I'll send the prepaid return label to the email we have on file.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Will there be anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
